headline: DeepSeek holds 34.5% of all tokens, and its flagship keeps its record on day four
summary: DeepSeek now carries 34.5% of all tokens, and deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 has held its all-time 20.4% token-share record for four straight days. Together, DeepSeek, Zhipu AI and OpenAI account for 57.0% of usage.
highlights: Kimi K3.1 Pro (moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro-20261023) leapt 25 places to 18th and set a fresh all-time record at 1.3% token share.
MiniMax M3.1 Flash (minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash-20261019) climbed 12 places to 19th, also setting a new all-time record at 1.1%.
Four newcomers landed at ranks 44 to 49: openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions-20261006, thinkingmachines/inkling-20260715:free, google/gemini-3.7-flash-20260813 and google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-20260403.
Four models fell off the chart: anthropic/claude-opus-5-20260723, anthropic/claude-fable-5.1-20260831, openai/gpt-oss-120b and openai/gpt-5.6-sol-20260709.
